title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
Residential Property Paralegal - Farnham

Location: Farnham, Berkshire

Salary: Competitive + benefits

Type: Full-time, Permanent

About the Firm

Our client is a well-established, client-focused private practice law firm with a strong reputation across the Surrey and Berkshire. Its busy Residential Property Department handles a wide range of conveyancing matters for a loyal client base. Due to continued growth, the firm is seeking an enthusiastic Paralegal to join its friendly Wokingham office.

The Role

You will provide key support to the firm's Conveyancing Solicitors on a variety of residential property transactions. This is an excellent opportunity to develop conveyancing skills within a supportive and professional environment.

Key Duties include:
- Opening new files and ensuring they are fully compliant with regulatory and internal procedures
- Preparing and issuing draft contract packs to purchasers' Solicitors
- Assisting with post-exchange administration and completion preparation
- Drafting and submitting Certificates of Title (COTs)
- Carrying out final searches prior to completion
- Preparing and submitting SDLT returns and AP1 applications to HM Land Registry
- Dealing with Land Registry requisitions promptly and accurately
- Liaising with clients, estate agents, mortgage lenders and other third parties as required

Your Profile
- Previous experience as a Conveyancing Assistant or Paralegal within a residential property team
- Good understanding of the conveyancing process from file opening through to post-completion
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- Confident IT skills, including case management systems
- Excellent communication and client care abilities
- Ability to work well under pressure and meet deadlines

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary depending on experience
- Supportive and friendly team environment
- Opportunities for career development and training
- Modern offices in Wokingham town centre with good transport links

How to Apply

If you are a proactive Residential Property Paralegal looking to progress your career with a reputable law firm in Farnham, please send your CV and a covering letter to

please email your CV, or call Gayle Woolf at G2 Legal.

title: Legal Administrator
description:
Legal Administrator / Legal Office Assistant

Surrey Commercial Property

A well-established and highly regarded law firm with a strong commercial practice is seeking an experienced Legal Administrator / Legal Office Assistant to join its Surrey team.

The firm provides a broad range of legal services to businesses and individuals and has a well-established Commercial Property practice. The successful candidate will work within a professional legal environment, providing administrative and organisational support to the legal team.

The Role

The successful candidate will provide day-to-day administrative support to solicitors and the wider legal team, helping to ensure the smooth running of the office and assisting with the administration of commercial property matters.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a legal academic background and previous experience within a legal office who is looking to develop their career within a respected commercial law environment.

The Ideal Candidate

The firm is looking for someone who has:
- An academic background in Law, such as an LLB, GDL, LPC or equivalent legal qualification
- Previous legal office or law firm experience
- An interest in Commercial Property
- Strong administrative and organisational skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- The ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively within a busy professional environment
- A professional and personable approach when dealing with clients and colleagues
- The ability to handle confidential information with discretion
- The ability to commute to Surrey and work from the firm's Surrey office

The role would particularly suit a law graduate, legal administrator, legal assistant or junior legal professional who already has some experience working within a law firm and is keen to build further experience within Commercial Property.

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity to join an established legal practice and gain valuable experience supporting a Commercial Property team.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced legal professionals, develop their understanding of commercial property work and build on their existing legal and administrative experience.

title: Legal Assistant / Paralegal
description:
Legal Assistant / Paralegal - Residential Conveyancing

Location - Guildford
Salary - Up to 28,000pa DOE

Due to rural location, you must have your own transport!

A fantastic opportunity for a graduate seeking to join an established Surrey-based law firm is looking to recruit a Legal Assistant / Paralegal to join their Residential Property team.

Working alongside an experienced Residential Property Associate, you will provide day-to-day legal and administrative support while developing your knowledge and experience within residential conveyancing.

This role would suit someone who enjoys working within a small, busy and friendly team, is highly organised and is confident taking ownership of tasks to support the wider department.

Key Responsibilities
- Providing administrative and legal support throughout the residential conveyancing process
- Carrying out property searches
- Preparing completion statements
- Assisting with pre- and post-completion work
- Preparing accurate and timely correspondence and documentation
- Assisting with the management and maintenance of client files
- Supporting the smooth progression of property transactions from instruction through to completion
- Producing documents independently and accurately
- Liaising with clients and third parties by telephone and in person
- Providing a professional and high level of client service

Requirements
- Previous experience working within a Residential Property / Residential Conveyancing team
- Good understanding of the residential conveyancing process
- Excellent attention to detail
- Fast and accurate typing skills
- Experience using a legal case management system
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Highly organised with the ability to manage competing priorities
- Strong team player who is happy to take ownership of tasks
- Friendly and professional approach
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook
- Experience with digital audio / dictation software would be advantageous

title: Legal PA - Private Client
description:
Legal PA - Private Client

Full-time, Permanent, Office-based

Leatherhead

My client is recruiting for a PA to join their Private Client team in the Leatherhead office. Their focus is on providing outstanding client service, through expert, clear advice and assistance with Private Client matters, delivered in a professional and engaged way that leads to high levels of client satisfaction. They work together at all levels of our team to create a supportive and pro-active environment to achieve this.

The prime role of the PA is to provide direct support to the Fee Earners in the Private Client team to enable them to operate at optimum efficiency. This will include but will not be limited to the main responsibilities given below. The PA is expected to use a high degree of self-management and initiative.

Key duties:
- Prepare correspondence and documents through audio-typing and word processing.
- Attend clients both in person and on the telephone and to provide such support in a professional and friendly manner in keeping with the firm's standards for client care.
- Administer files which will include daily filing and the opening, closing, storage and retrieval of client files.
- Make appointments, arrange meetings and to maintain an up to date diary for their fee earners.
- Prepare the conference room for meetings as necessary.
- Provide support to other secretaries as required.
- Provide guidance to junior and temporary secretaries.
- Ensure the confidentiality of all the Firm's and clients' documentation and information.
- Undertake on-line form filling requirements
- Prepare mail and enclosures for dispatch.

Skills and experience required:
- Substantial previous Legal Secretary / PA experience including at least 2 years' experience
- Ideally experience within Private Client although this is not essential
- Fast touch-typing skills
- Well-developed interpersonal, social and communication skills including an appreciation of the vulnerability of some of our clients, both generally and also specifically at distressing times.
- Advanced IT skills in relevant packages
- Demonstrates a pro-active approach to work and clients
- Progresses client matters without supervision and in the absence of fee-earners
- Ability to work to deadlines and under pressure
- Team working skills.

title: Private Client Legal Secretary
description:

Apply Now

Apply today or contact us for a confidential discussion.

title: Residential Property Paralegal - Salary up to &;40,000 Highly reputable firm

If you're looking for a position where you can feel valued, stay long-term, and still be recognised for the work you do, I'd love to chat with you.
